slides.headline: OPENAI JUST RELEASED A PUBLIC BETA FOR ITS AGENTS API
slides.sub: This API lets developers build cloud-based agents that run for hours.
slides.image_prompt: A developer working on a laptop in a modern office, focused and engaged with code on the screen, with ambient lighting.

slides.headline: THE AGENTS API RUNS ON THE SAME INFRASTRUCTURE AS CODEX AND CHATGPT
slides.sub: It includes features like automatic context management and parallel tool use.
slides.image_prompt: Close-up of a computer code on a screen, with a hand typing on a keyboard, conveying a sense of coding and technology.

slides.headline: DEVELOPERS CAN CHOOSE BETWEEN OPENAI-HOSTED OR PARTNER PLATFORMS
slides.sub: Partners include Cloudflare, Vercel, and Oracle, with no extra fees.
slides.image_prompt: A team of diverse developers collaborating around a table with laptops, discussing and pointing at code on a screen.

slides.headline: BILLING FOR THE API IS BASED SOLELY ON TOKEN USAGE
slides.sub: This makes it accessible for a range of projects and budgets.
slides.image_prompt: A person analyzing data on a laptop with charts in the background, indicating financial analysis in tech.

slides.headline: AND IT OFFERS CAPABILITIES FOR DELEGATING TASKS TO SUB-AGENTS
